Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

This existing independently source-qualified family now has separate actual author, source-verifier and adversarial reviews of complete pinned creator-card text and exact substantive provenance, workflow, schema, access/rights declarations and limitations. The inspected README revision is documentation identity, not a verified download/recount or immutable inventory of the dataset payload. Configurations, stages, models and regenerated traces do not add families. No paper/code/media/payload, experimental performance, upstream-rights clearance or operational execution audit is represented. Original unsuccessful hypotheses and real negative reviews remain candidates.

  • The exact source is SmallDoge/SmallThoughts; it is not automatically conflated with other similarly named datasets or upstream OpenThoughts.
